title: Radicial and universally injective morphisms of schemes
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. The morphism $f$ is *universally injective* if for every morphism of schemes $Y'\to Y$ the base change $X\times_YY'\to Y'$ (the projection from the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]) is injective on underlying sets. It is *radicial* if it is injective on underlying sets and for every $x\in X$ the extension of residue fields $\kappa(f(x))\subseteq\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is purely inseparable. The following are equivalent (Stacks Lemma 01S4): (1) for every field $K$ the map $X(K)=\operatorname{Mor}(\operatorname{Spec}K,X)\to Y(K)=\operatorname{Mor}(\operatorname{Spec}K,Y)$, $x\mapsto f\circ x$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], is injective; (2) $f$ is universally injective; (3) $f$ is radicial; (4) the diagonal $X\to X\times_YX$ is surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism].
